preamble.summary: **4QEzra** (4Q117) is the only Qumran witness to Ezra, preserving small fragments of chapters 4-6 — significantly, including portions of the Aramaic section (Ezra 4:8–6:18). The fragment confirms the antiquity of the bilingual Hebrew/Aramaic structure that distinguishes Ezra (along with Daniel and a few verses of Jeremiah).
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The fragmentary readings confirm the bilingual Hebrew/Aramaic structure of Ezra.
preamble.coverage_assessment: fragmentary; ~15 verses attested across the listed manuscripts.
